description: This file contains shell script functions related to system image upgrade processes for embedded devices, including partition management, EFI system partition handling, and device-specific checks.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the system image's partition layout matches the current device, determines if a full image write is needed.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration backup data to the designated partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_efi_system_partition
methods.description: Updates EFI system partition files (EFI boot files) from a given image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the main upgrade procedure, including partition updates and bootloader configuration.
